name: apple-music
description: Control playback and safely manage the user's Music library on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Control playback and manage the user's Music library.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and control Music playback, find library tracks with cloud/local status, and manage regular playlists through macOS AppleScript with identity checks, network gates, confirmations, and read-back verification.
defaultPrompt: Use $apple-music to show what is playing without changing playback.
